description_for_human: Portfolio MI answers, the latest investor deck, and the latest canonical loan tape from Trakt.
description_for_model: Trakt is the governed source of truth for portfolio management information. Use askTraktMi for every question about portfolio data, balances, originations, LTV, regions, performance, or reporting-period comparisons — never estimate or invent portfolio figures; when askTraktMi returns a workspaceUrl, surface it as a link. Use getArtifact to retrieve any downloadable Trakt artifact (investor_deck, canonical_tape, mapping_report, validation_report, esma_xml, or any type Trakt adds later) — pass the artifactType that matches what the user asked for. Trakt validates the type server-side and lists the available types if it does not recognise one.

functions.name: askTraktMi
functions.description: Answer a natural-language portfolio MI question using Trakt's deterministic MI engine. Returns the answer, reporting context, the supporting values it was computed from, and — when the richer React MI Workspace would materially help — a workspaceUrl deep link.

functions.name: getArtifact
functions.description: Retrieve metadata and a short-lived download link for the latest generated Trakt artifact of a given artifactType (e.g. investor_deck, canonical_tape, mapping_report, validation_report, esma_xml). Trakt validates the type server-side; new artifact types become available without any package change.
